question: win rate keseluruhan berapa?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Berapa deal won dan berapa deal lost tahun ini?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: berapa jumlah deal pipeline dan jumlah deal closed?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS jumlah_pipeline, countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS jumlah_closed FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Hitung total forecast dari deal pipeline.
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: rata2 nilai deal won vs lost

question: Berapa tiket urgent yang masih terbuka?
sql: SELECT countIf(t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS jumlah_urgent_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: rasio pelanggan churn terhadap seluruh pelanggan
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Berapa persen aktivitas yang bersentimen positif?

question: jumlah pelanggan aktif dan jumlah pelanggan churned
sql: SELECT countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_active, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churned FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Total nilai pipeline yang ada di stage negotiation
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'negotiation') AS nilai_negotiation FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: berapa meeting dan berapa demo yang tercatat bulan ini?
sql: SELECT countIf(a.type = 'meeting') AS jumlah_meeting, countIf(a.type = 'demo') AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket high dibanding tiket low
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'high'), 2) AS rata_jam_high, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'low'), 2) AS rata_jam_low FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: berapa pelanggan unik yg pernah bikin tiket urgent?
sql: SELECT uniqExactIf(t.customer_id, t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: win rate bulan ini
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Berapa deal won yang bernilai di atas 300 ribu?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 300000) AS jumlah_won_besar FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: jumlah customer per status dalam satu baris: lead, prospect, active
sql: SELECT countIf(c.status = 'lead') AS jumlah_lead, countIf(c.status = 'prospect') AS jumlah_prospect, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_active FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Berapa total omset dan total nilai deal lost tahun lalu?
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost') AS total_nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())

question: rata-rata probabilitas deal di stage proposal vs negotiation
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(d.probability, d.stage = 'proposal'), 2) AS rata_prob_proposal, round(avgIf(d.probability, d.stage = 'negotiation'), 2) AS rata_prob_negotiation FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: berapa customer bertag high-value yang berstatus active?
sql: SELECT countIf(has(c.tags, 'high-value') AND c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: jumlah sales per tim, kolom terpisah untuk tiap tim
sql: SELECT countIf(r.team = 'Inbound') AS jumlah_inbound, countIf(r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise') AS jumlah_outbound, countIf(r.team = 'Account-Management') AS jumlah_account_mgmt FROM sales_reps AS r

question: Berapa deal yang melibatkan produk CRM-Connect dari seluruh deal won?
sql: SELECT countIf(has(d.products_involved, 'CRM-Connect')) AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: rasio tiket yang sudah resolved atau closed
sql: SELECT round(countIf(t.status IN ('resolved','closed')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: total durasi call dan email dalam menit
sql: SELECT sumIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'call') AS menit_call, sumIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'email') AS menit_email FROM activities AS a

question: Berapa customer yang punya region APAC dibanding total customer?
sql: SELECT countIf(c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC') AS jumlah_apac, count() AS total_customer FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Berapa deal pipeline yang probabilitasnya minimal 70?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.probability >= 70) AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Hitung persentase deal won dari semua deal yang dibuat tahun ini
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / count(), 2) AS rasio_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: rata2 durasi demo yg sentimennya positif
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'positive'), 2) AS rata_durasi_demo_positif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo'

question: jumlah tiket per prioritas dalam satu baris
sql: SELECT countIf(t.priority = 'low') AS jumlah_low, countIf(t.priority = 'medium') AS jumlah_medium, countIf(t.priority = 'high') AS jumlah_high, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: berapa deal yang closed bulan lalu, won vs lost
sql: SELECT countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Persentase customer Enterprise dari seluruh pelanggan (rasio)
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.segment = 'Enterprise') / count(), 2) AS porsi_enterprise FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: rasio deal lost terhadap seluruh deal closed bulan ini
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: berapa tiket yang resolusinya lebih dari 48 jam dibanding total tiket resolved?
sql: SELECT countIf(t.resolution_time_hours > 48) AS jumlah_lambat, countIf(t.status = 'resolved') AS total_resolved FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: Hitung weighted pipeline khusus stage proposal
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage = 'proposal') AS weighted_proposal FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: jumlah aktivitas negatif dan total aktivitas 30 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif, count() AS total_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: Berapa pelanggan unik yg punya deal won?
sql: SELECT uniqExactIf(d.customer_id, d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: berapa pelanggan unik yang ikut meeting minggu ini?
sql: SELECT uniqExactIf(a.customer_id, a.type = 'meeting') AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(today(), 1)

question: nilai rata-rata deal pipeline yg ada produk Analytics-Suite
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(d.value, has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite')), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: berapa deal won tanpa produk sama sekali?
sql: SELECT countIf(length(d.products_involved) = 0) AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Tampilkan win rate per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: win rate tiap tim sales, urutkan dari tertinggi
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: win rate per bulan sepanjang tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 0), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Sales dengan win rate di atas 0.5 dan minimal 10 deal closed, tampilkan win rate-nya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 10 AND countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.5 ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: 3 sales dengan win rate terendah (minimal 15 deal closed)
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 15 ORDER BY win_rate ASC LIMIT 3

question: Berapa omset dan berapa nilai deal lost per segmen?
sql: SELECT c.segment, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost') AS nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: persen tiket urgent per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: rasio churn per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: Forecast per tim sales
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY forecast DESC

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, hitung jumlah deal pipeline dan jumlah deal closed
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS jumlah_pipeline, countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS jumlah_closed FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY wilayah

question: rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket urgent vs medium per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'urgent'), 2) AS rata_jam_urgent, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'medium'), 2) AS rata_jam_medium FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: rasio aktivitas bersentimen negatif per tipe aktivitas
sql: SELECT a.type, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: Per tim sales, hitung aktivitas positif, netral, dan negatif
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') AS jumlah_positif, countIf(a.sentiment = 'neutral') AS jumlah_netral, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Tiap tier pelanggan, berapa tiket yang belum selesai dan berapa total tiket?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS tiket_belum_selesai, count() AS total_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier

question: win rate deal yg melibatkan Security-Plus dibanding yg tidak
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus')) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus')), 2) AS win_rate_dengan_security, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND NOT has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus')) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND NOT has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus')), 2) AS win_rate_tanpa_security FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Win rate per tahun closing
sql: SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') GROUP BY tahun ORDER BY tahun

question: Rasio deal won untuk tiap produk
sql: SELECT product, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product GROUP BY product ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: jumlah pelanggan unik per tim sales berdasarkan aktivitas positif
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExactIf(a.customer_id, a.sentiment = 'positive') AS jumlah_pelanggan_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Persentase tiket resolved dari semua tiket per prioritas
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(countIf(t.status = 'resolved') / count(), 2) AS rasio_resolved FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority

question: Per sales, jumlah deal won dan total omset hanya dari deal won 6 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Berapa rata-rata nilai deal won per tier pelanggan dibanding rata-rata nilai deal lost-nya?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_nilai_won, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost'), 2) AS rata_nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier

question: jumlah pelanggan per status untuk tiap segmen, kolom terpisah per status
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.status = 'lead') AS jumlah_lead, countIf(c.status = 'prospect') AS jumlah_prospect, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_active, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churned FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per tipe hanya untuk aktivitas bersentimen positif
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'positive'), 2) AS rata_durasi_positif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: Persentase customer bertag tech di tiap segmen (rasio 0-1)
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(has(c.tags, 'tech')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_tech FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: jumlah customer bertag strategic atau high-value per tier
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, countIf(hasAny(c.tags, ['strategic','high-value'])) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY tier

question: Per bulan tahun ini: jumlah tiket urgent dan total tiket
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent, count() AS total_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Tampilkan rasio deal won per wilayah sales
sql: SELECT r.region, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region

question: Perusahaan mana yg rasio tiket urgent-nya di atas 0.2 dan punya minimal 5 tiket? tampilkan rasionya
sql: SELECT c.company, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company HAVING count() >= 5 AND countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count() > 0.2 ORDER BY rasio_urgent DESC

question: Berapa weighted pipeline per stage (qualification, proposal, negotiation)?
sql: SELECT d.stage, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.stage

question: Per tim sales, rata-rata nilai pipeline dan rata-rata nilai deal won
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')), 2) AS rata_nilai_pipeline, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_nilai_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: jumlah demo, meeting, call per wilayah pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, countIf(a.type = 'demo') AS jumlah_demo, countIf(a.type = 'meeting') AS jumlah_meeting, countIf(a.type = 'call') AS jumlah_call FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY wilayah

question: Persen pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent di tiap segmen, hitung dari jumlah pelanggan unik
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(uniqExactIf(t.customer_id, t.priority = 'urgent') / uniqExact(t.customer_id), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: nilai deal pipeline yang probabilitasnya di bawah 30 vs di atas 70
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.probability < 30) AS nilai_prob_rendah, sumIf(d.value, d.probability > 70) AS nilai_prob_tinggi FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Rasio lost per tim sales dari deal closed
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya lebih dari 2 deal closed dengan win rate 1? tampilkan jumlah won-nya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 2 AND countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) = 1 ORDER BY jumlah_won DESC

question: Berapa persen aktivitas call yang bersentimen positif untuk tiap tim?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(a.type = 'call' AND a.sentiment = 'positive') / countIf(a.type = 'call'), 2) AS rasio_call_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Hitung omset per kuartal tahun lalu dan jumlah deal won-nya
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: Sales mana yang win rate-nya di atas rata-rata win rate seluruh perusahaan? tampilkan win rate-nya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > (SELECT countIf(d2.stage = 'won') / countIf(d2.stage IN ('won','lost')) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL) ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Bandingkan win rate tiap segmen pelanggan antara tahun ini dan tahun lalu
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())), 0), 2) AS win_rate_tahun_ini, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())), 0), 2) AS win_rate_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Per sales, win rate dan rasio deal pipeline terhadap seluruh deal miliknya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 0), 2) AS win_rate, round(countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: Tim dengan win rate tertinggi untuk deal bernilai di atas 250 ribu
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 250000) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.value > 250000), 0), 2) AS win_rate_deal_besar FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY win_rate_deal_besar DESC LIMIT 1

question: Berapa persen dari total omset yang disumbang masing-masing segmen? (rasio 0-1)
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') / (SELECT sum(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won'), 2) AS porsi_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Segmen mana yang porsi tiket urgent-nya lebih tinggi dari porsi urgent seluruh tiket?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment HAVING countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count() > (SELECT countIf(t2.priority = 'urgent') / count() FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL)

question: Per sales: jumlah deal won, jumlah deal lost, dan win rate, hanya yang punya deal closed
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0 ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Rasio forecast terhadap total nilai pipeline per tim sales
sql: SELECT r.team, round(sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) / nullIf(sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')), 0), 2) AS rasio_forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Per bulan tahun ini: jumlah deal won, jumlah deal lost, win rate, dan omset
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 0), 2) AS win_rate, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang tiketnya lebih dari 5 dan rasio tiket urgent-nya lebih dari 0.25, plus jumlah tiket dan rasionya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_tiket > 5 AND countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count() > 0.25 ORDER BY rasio_urgent DESC

question: Conversion rate dari semua deal yg dibuat tahun lalu menjadi won, per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / count(), 2) AS conversion_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.created_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment

question: Berapa rata-rata hari closing deal won dan deal lost per tim sales?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date), d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_hari_won, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date), d.stage = 'lost'), 2) AS rata_hari_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Perbandingan jumlah pelanggan unik dihubungi vs pelanggan unik dengan sentimen negatif, per sales, top 5 berdasarkan sentimen negatif
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS pelanggan_dihubungi, uniqExactIf(a.customer_id, a.sentiment = 'negative') AS pelanggan_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY pelanggan_negatif DESC LIMIT 5

question: Per industri pelanggan, win rate dan total omset, hanya industri dengan minimal 50 deal closed
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY industri HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 50 ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Segmen dengan rasio deal lost di atas 0.3 dari deal closed
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.3

question: Per tag pelanggan, hitung win rate
sql: SELECT tag, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag GROUP BY tag ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: jumlah deal won dan deal lost untuk tiap tier pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier

question: Berapa pelanggan unik per segmen yang punya deal pipeline vs deal won?
sql: SELECT c.segment, uniqExactIf(d.customer_id, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS pelanggan_pipeline, uniqExactIf(d.customer_id, d.stage = 'won') AS pelanggan_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Rata-rata jumlah produk per deal won dibanding deal lost
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(length(d.products_involved), d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_produk_won, round(avgIf(length(d.products_involved), d.stage = 'lost'), 2) AS rata_produk_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: nilai deal pipeline yang mengandung API-Gateway per tim sales
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND has(d.products_involved, 'API-Gateway')) AS nilai_pipeline_api FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: jumlah pelanggan per wilayah yang berstatus active dan yang churned
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_active, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churned FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY wilayah

question: Rasio pelanggan high-value per tier
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(countIf(has(c.tags, 'high-value')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_high_value FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY tier

question: jumlah pelanggan yg punya minimal 2 tag, per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(length(c.tags) >= 2) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: Win rate deal Cloud-Storage-Pro
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'Cloud-Storage-Pro')

question: Per segmen, forecast deal pipeline yang melibatkan lebih dari satu produk
sql: SELECT c.segment, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND length(d.products_involved) > 1) AS forecast_multi_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Rata-rata durasi call bersentimen negatif dibanding positif per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'negative'), 2) AS rata_durasi_negatif, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'positive'), 2) AS rata_durasi_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'call' GROUP BY c.segment

question: jumlah tiket baru per minggu 8 minggu terakhir, pisahkan yang urgent
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent, countIf(t.priority != 'urgent') AS jumlah_lainnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Perusahaan mana yang punya lebih dari 95 deal won? tampilkan jumlah won dan win rate-nya
sql: SELECT c.company, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company HAVING jumlah_won > 95 ORDER BY jumlah_won DESC

question: Berapa pelanggan unik yang dihubungi lewat call vs email per tim sales
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExactIf(a.customer_id, a.type = 'call') AS pelanggan_call, uniqExactIf(a.customer_id, a.type = 'email') AS pelanggan_email FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Rasio tiket yang waktu penyelesaiannya di atas 24 jam dari tiket resolved, per prioritas
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(countIf(t.resolution_time_hours > 24) / countIf(t.status = 'resolved'), 2) AS rasio_lambat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority

question: total nilai deal won dari pelanggan baru vs lama (pelanggan dibuat tahun ini vs sebelumnya)
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_pelanggan_baru, sumIf(d.value, c.created_at < toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_pelanggan_lama FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Tampilkan persentase deal won per wilayah pelanggan hanya untuk Enterprise
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY wilayah

question: jumlah aktivitas weekend vs weekday
sql: SELECT countIf(toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) IN (6, 7)) AS aktivitas_akhir_pekan, countIf(toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) <= 5) AS aktivitas_hari_kerja FROM activities AS a

question: jumlah deal yang dibuat pagi (sebelum jam 12) vs siang/sore per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(toHour(d.created_date) < 12) AS deal_pagi, countIf(toHour(d.created_date) >= 12) AS deal_siang_sore FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Berapa sales per wilayah yang punya deal won tahun ini?
sql: SELECT r.region, uniqExactIf(d.rep_id, d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS jumlah_sales_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region

question: Rata-rata nilai deal pipeline per stage untuk pelanggan tier Gold
sql: SELECT d.stage, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' GROUP BY d.stage

question: Persentase pelanggan yang punya tag finance per wilayah (rasio)
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, round(countIf(has(c.tags, 'finance')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_finance FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY wilayah

question: Per tim, jumlah sales yang punya deal pipeline lebih dari 20
sql: SELECT x.team, countIf(x.jumlah_pipeline > 20) AS jumlah_sales FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.team AS team, countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS jumlah_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.team) AS x GROUP BY x.team

question: Berapa persen tiket yang masih terbuka tiap bulan sepanjang tahun ini?
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, round(countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: jumlah deal closed per tim berdasarkan hasil (won/lost) bulan lalu
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.team

question: omset kuartal ini dan forecast saat ini per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS omset_kuartal_ini, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Per sales, berapa persen aktivitasnya yang berupa demo?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(a.type = 'demo') / count(), 2) AS rasio_demo FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY rasio_demo DESC

question: rata-rata nilai deal won untuk pelanggan dengan tag strategic dan yang tidak
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(d.value, has(c.tags, 'strategic')), 2) AS rata_nilai_strategic, round(avgIf(d.value, NOT has(c.tags, 'strategic')), 2) AS rata_nilai_non_strategic FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: jumlah tiket per status utk pelanggan Enterprise vs SMB
sql: SELECT t.status, countIf(c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS tiket_enterprise, countIf(c.segment = 'SMB') AS tiket_smb FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY t.status

question: Sales dengan rasio deal lost lebih dari 0.4 dari deal closed-nya (minimal 20 closed), tampilkan rasionya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 20 AND countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.4 ORDER BY rasio_lost DESC

question: Sales mana yang win rate tahun ini lebih tinggi dari win rate tahun lalu? tampilkan kedua angkanya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())), 0), 2) AS win_rate_tahun_ini, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())), 0), 2) AS win_rate_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING win_rate_tahun_ini > win_rate_sebelumnya

question: Per segmen: jumlah pelanggan, jumlah pelanggan yang churn, dan rasio churn, hanya segmen dengan rasio churn di atas 0.1
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churned, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment HAVING countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count() > 0.1

question: Berapa selisih win rate antara tim Inbound dan Outbound-Enterprise?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(r.team = 'Inbound' AND d.stage = 'won') / countIf(r.team = 'Inbound' AND d.stage IN ('won','lost')) - countIf(r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise' AND d.stage = 'won') / countIf(r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise' AND d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS selisih_win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id

question: Distribusi stage: persentase tiap stage terhadap seluruh deal, per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.stage = 'qualification') / count(), 2) AS rasio_qualification, round(countIf(d.stage = 'proposal') / count(), 2) AS rasio_proposal, round(countIf(d.stage = 'negotiation') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negotiation, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / count(), 2) AS rasio_won, round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / count(), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya deal pipeline dengan forecast lebih dari 400 ribu? sertakan forecast-nya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING forecast > 400000 ORDER BY forecast DESC

question: Sales yang forecast pipeline-nya lebih besar dari omset won tahun ini; tampilkan keduanya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING forecast > omset_ytd

question: Berapa kali lipat nilai rata-rata deal won dibanding deal lost per segmen? (rasio)
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost'), 0), 2) AS rasio_won_vs_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Per sales, win rate untuk deal dengan lebih dari 2 produk dan deal dengan paling banyak 2 produk
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND length(d.products_involved) > 2) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND length(d.products_involved) > 2), 0), 2) AS win_rate_banyak_produk, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND length(d.products_involved) <= 2) / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND length(d.products_involved) <= 2), 0), 2) AS win_rate_sedikit_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: Win rate per produk untuk deal pelanggan region EMEA
sql: SELECT product, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 0), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'EMEA' GROUP BY product ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Persentase pelanggan Enterprise yang punya tiket urgent terhadap seluruh pelanggan Enterprise yang pernah bikin tiket
sql: SELECT round(uniqExactIf(t.customer_id, t.priority = 'urgent') / uniqExact(t.customer_id), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: Per wilayah sales, rasio aktivitas negatif terhadap total dan rasio deal lost terhadap deal closed
sql: SELECT act_agg.region, act_agg.rasio_negatif, deal_agg.rasio_lost FROM (SELECT r.region AS region, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region) AS act_agg INNER JOIN (SELECT r.region AS region, round(countIf(d.stage = 'lost') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS rasio_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region) AS deal_agg ON act_agg.region = deal_agg.region

question: Berapa persen pelanggan active yang punya deal won tahun ini? (dari seluruh pelanggan active unik di deal)
sql: SELECT round(uniqExactIf(d.customer_id, d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) / uniqExact(d.customer_id), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active'

question: Tim mana yang rata-rata probabilitas pipeline-nya di atas 50 dan forecast-nya paling tinggi? tampilkan keduanya
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avgIf(d.probability, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')), 2) AS rata_probabilitas, sumIf(d.value * d.probability / 100, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team HAVING avgIf(d.probability, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) > 50 ORDER BY forecast DESC

question: Per bulan tahun ini, share omset tim Account-Management terhadap total omset bulan itu
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(sumIf(d.value, r.team = 'Account-Management') / nullIf(sum(d.value), 0), 2) AS porsi_account_mgmt FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Perusahaan dengan rasio sentimen negatif di atas 0.25 dan minimal 20 aktivitas, tampilkan rasionya
sql: SELECT c.company, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company HAVING count() >= 20 AND countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count() > 0.25 ORDER BY rasio_negatif DESC

question: Rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket urgent dibanding rata-rata semua tiket resolved, per segmen (rasio)
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'urgent') / nullIf(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 0), 2) AS rasio_urgent_vs_semua FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Berapa deal yang masuk stage negotiation dari deal pipeline, per sales top 5, plus rasionya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage = 'negotiation') AS jumlah_negotiation, round(countIf(d.stage = 'negotiation') / countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')), 2) AS rasio_negotiation FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_negotiation DESC LIMIT 5

question: Tiap wilayah pelanggan: jumlah tiket urgent yang belum selesai dan jumlah pelanggan unik yang terdampak
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS tiket_urgent_terbuka, uniqExactIf(t.customer_id, t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS pelanggan_terdampak FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY wilayah

question: Bandingkan omset 3 bulan terakhir dengan omset 3 bulan sebelumnya per tim sales dan hitung rasio pertumbuhannya
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 3)) AS omset_3_bulan_terakhir, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) AND d.closed_date < subtractMonths(now(), 3)) AS omset_3_bulan_sebelumnya, round(omset_3_bulan_terakhir / nullIf(omset_3_bulan_sebelumnya, 0), 2) AS rasio_pertumbuhan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team

question: Pelanggan yang semua deal closed-nya lost (minimal 2 deal closed), tampilkan jumlah lost-nya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'won') = 0 AND count() >= 2 ORDER BY jumlah_lost DESC

question: Persentase deal won yang nilainya di atas rata-rata nilai semua deal won, per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.value > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_di_atas_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment

question: jumlah sales per tim yang win rate-nya di atas 0.55, hanya hitung sales dengan minimal 10 deal closed
sql: SELECT x.team, countIf(x.win_rate > 0.55) AS jumlah_sales FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.team AS team, countIf(d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 0) AS win_rate, countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS jumlah_closed FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.team) AS x WHERE x.jumlah_closed >= 10 GROUP BY x.team

question: Per kuartal tahun lalu, win rate dan rata-rata nilai deal won
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / nullIf(countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 0), 2) AS win_rate, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_nilai_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: Share jumlah aktivitas tiap tipe terhadap total aktivitas pelanggan Enterprise
sql: SELECT a.type, round(count() / (SELECT count() FROM activities AS a2 INNER JOIN customers AS c2 FINAL ON a2.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE c2.segment = 'Enterprise'), 2) AS porsi_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY a.type

question: Sales dengan jumlah deal won terbanyak untuk deal bernilai di atas 400 ribu, 5 teratas, plus total nilainya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 400000) AS jumlah_won_besar, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 400000) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_won_besar DESC LIMIT 5

question: Per status pelanggan, rata-rata jumlah tiket urgent per pelanggan
sql: SELECT x.status, round(avg(x.jumlah_urgent), 2) AS rata_urgent_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.status AS status, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.status) AS x GROUP BY x.status

question: Deal terlama dalam pipeline vs deal won tercepat: rata-rata umur deal pipeline (hari sejak dibuat) dan rata-rata hari closing deal won, per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, now()), d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')), 2) AS rata_umur_pipeline_hari, round(avgIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date), d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_hari_closing_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Sales mana yang meeting-nya lebih dari 20% total aktivitasnya? sertakan rasio meeting
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(a.type = 'meeting') / count(), 2) AS rasio_meeting FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(a.type = 'meeting') / count() > 0.2 ORDER BY rasio_meeting DESC

question: pelanggan unik per tier yang punya tiket high atau urgent
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, uniqExactIf(t.customer_id, t.priority IN ('high','urgent')) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier

question: Per tim sales, persentase omset won yang berasal dari deal dengan produk Analytics-Suite
sql: SELECT r.team, round(sumIf(d.value, has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite')) / nullIf(sum(d.value), 0), 2) AS porsi_analytics FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team
